Name: Pierre Sells Sprinklers (1.6 compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds the following[/size][size=3] to the bottom of Pierre's sale menu (prices calculated based on crafting material costs):
[/size]
[u]Sprinklers:[/u][list]
[*]Sprinkler- 180
[*]Quality Sprinkler- 420
[*]Iridium Sprinkler - 1750
[/list][u]
Attachments:[/u]
[list]
[*]Enricher - 500
[*]Pressure Nozzle - 500
[/list]All prices are easily configurable using GMCM, and everything is buyable starting in year 1!

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
No known issues with any other mods. If you have a mod that completely overrides the Seed shop list then I could see those conflicting.

[size=4][b]To Install:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! Just drag this bad boy into your mods folder and you should be good to
go! If you want to change the prices, you can edit the config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit it right in your game!

[size=4][b]To Uninstall:[/b][/size]
Delete it! Shouldn't cause any issues in current playthroughs, it only touches the Seed shop.

[size=4][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self-Serve[/url] to access the shop even when he isn't there
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20648]Friendships Affect Prices[/url] for obvious reasons
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26961]Robin Sells Machines[/url] to add most machines and materials to Robin's shop
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27102]Clint Shop Overhaul[/url] for machines that felt they fit Clint's shop more
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27249]Willy Sells Fish Machines[/url] for machines that felt they fit Willy's shop more
